auxiliary.frequency: Final PPO epoch of every 128-control update
auxiliary.objective: Negative undiscounted original task reward over valid remaining reference steps; deterministic actor means and differentiable predicted observations.
auxiliary.gradient_scale: Detached rho * PPO-actor-gradient-norm / model-actor-gradient-norm, lambda capped at 100; combined gradient clipped at the original 0.5.

development.selection: Use only legacy eight dev states. Lexicographic: strict success count, median first strict failure, then position and orientation normalized common-prefix score; if within 5%, choose rho10. Freeze before core.

evaluation.development: Original eight repeatedly used conditions, explicitly seen development set.
evaluation.perturbation: Same 1mm object-position and 2mrad finger-position Gaussian family, qvel unchanged.
evaluation.heldout_usage: Generate now, do not use for configuration selection, stopping or model fitting. Evaluate all saved core checkpoints after core completion.

core.target_rule: Measure development seconds/control, reserve 15% timing margin and fixed evaluation allowance. Round common target down to 65536, cap 524288. Both arms start fresh from same source policy/optimizer, not development endpoints.

stopping.rule: On legacy dev only: stop BOTH arms at the same completed checkpoint if, for three consecutive checkpoint comparisons, neither has strict success and BOTH have median first failure <80% of their starting value, position AND orientation common-prefix errors >120% of start, and average episode length <80% of start. Early 0/8 alone never stops. Hard time/resource/nonfinite limits always apply.
stopping.switch_rule: Only within preauthorized candidate strengths; any core switch creates a separately labeled branch, retaining original matched P/M evidence.

confirmation.rule: Prefer one matched P/M replication if no sustained distribution-drift trigger. If M's observed-state 4-step model position AND reward errors both exceed 2x development baseline at two consecutive checkpoints and real dev performance degrades, allow one new-training-data-only model refresh, then compare fixed-old versus refreshed-model continuations from the same M policy/optimizer. Never fit evaluation episodes.

backup.selection: Source/reference/contact quality before policy trials; original spoon never relabeled or shortened. Backup creation optional if no credible alternative passes source-quality review.
